post.summary: Execute a browser authentication action
post.description: Single public Gateway endpoint for login, MFA, recovery, and browser-session actions. The browser session stays in an HttpOnly cookie and each request sends X-CSRF-TOKEN. Identity credentials and internal session or membership identifiers are never returned. login, verify, resend, and cancel use the challenge bound to the browser session; logout, revokeOthers, and switchOrganization require an authenticated session. The Gateway limits this route to 20 requests per minute. Identity additionally limits login to 10 attempts per email per five minutes, challenge issuance/resend to one per 60 seconds and five per user and purpose per hour, recovery requests to five per email per hour with a generic response, and verification to five failed codes per challenge.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Supported Identity action forwarded by the Gateway.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
parameters.description: CSRF token obtained from GET /csrf.

requestBody.description: JSON body varies by action. logout and revokeOthers accept an omitted or empty body.

200.description: Successful action. login and resend return a new challenge; verify returns the public principal and establishes the browser session; recover returns a generic acknowledgement; cancel, reset, logout, revokeOthers, and switchOrganization return an empty data array.

401.description: Authentication failed or the current session is invalid.

403.description: The action is not permitted, or the session needs current terms acceptance.

409.description: The submitted organization terms version is stale.

419.description: The browser CSRF token is missing or invalid.

422.description: Request validation failed or a challenge is invalid, expired, consumed, or no longer bound to this browser session.

429.description: The Gateway or Identity rate limit was reached.

503.description: A required Identity, configuration, or mail dependency is unavailable.

x-srd-auth-action-contracts.behavior: Checks credentials and current terms, then issues an MFA challenge without creating an authenticated session.
limits: Challenge: at least 60 seconds between issues and five per user/purpose/hour

x-srd-auth-action-contracts.behavior: Consumes the current browser-bound MFA challenge, then establishes the HttpOnly session and returns the public principal.
limits: Challenge: at most five failed codes

x-srd-auth-action-contracts.behavior: Consumes/replaces the current browser-bound challenge and issues a fresh challenge.
limits: Challenge: at least 60 seconds between issues and five per user/purpose/hour

x-srd-auth-action-contracts.behavior: Consumes the challenge and clears it from the browser session.
Requests password recovery. The success message is generic for unknown, throttled, or ineligible accounts.
Consumes a one-time recovery challenge, updates the password, revokes active sessions, and returns no session identifiers.
Revokes the current Identity session, clears the browser session, and returns no internal identifiers.
Revokes other active sessions while retaining the current session; revoked IDs stay server-side.
Checks destination membership and terms, rotates the server credential and browser session, then returns no credential.

get.description: Requiere la sesión srd_session y el permiso organization.manage. La frontera Gateway es externa, pero esta operación no es anónima. Gateway obtiene el principal de la sesión, firma el contexto interno dirigido a Records y conserva el alcance de la junta activa. Devuelve hasta 25 solicitudes por página, ordenadas de más reciente a más antigua, con historial y datos personales de la ficha. El cliente debe restringir y proteger la respuesta.

Gateway obtiene de Identity el principal y el contexto de junta activa; los campos organization_id, user_id y role del cuerpo no se usan para autorizar. Envía a Records un contexto interno firmado con emisor gateway. Records exige que la solicitud sea de tipo erasure, esté approved_pending_erasure o erasure_in_progress, que el responsable sea el principal actual, que version coincida y que confirmed sea aceptado. En la primera ejecución se desvinculan relaciones de Identity, se elimina la fila de persona en Records, se redactan resumen/decision de las solicitudes relacionadas, se registran eventos y se inicia la limpieza de fotos con Files. La implementación conserva identificadores de solicitud, persona, junta, actores, estados e historial; borra todas las filas person_export_jobs de la junta, no solo las de la persona objeto de la solicitud. No existe transaccion distribuida entre servicios. Records confirma erasure_in_progress mientras haya limpieza de Files pendiente y cambia a erased cuando Files completa el purgePerson. La llamada Records->Files puede esperar hasta 75 s, mientras Gateway espera como maximo 15 s por Records; un 503 o timeout puede dejar el resultado incierto. No hay reintento HTTP automatico ni Idempotency-Key. Tras un timeout o 409, consulta estado/version antes de decidir si reintentar; la misma version anterior no se vuelve a aceptar.
